description_summary: Use when a Postgres SQLSTATE or named unique, foreign-key, check, or not-null constraint fails through Drizzle.
should_trigger: Diagnose this Postgres unique constraint failure in a Drizzle repository.
Trace SQLSTATE 23503 back to the schema and migration state.
Find why a generated migration conflicts with existing rows.
Investigate a constraint name mismatch without resetting the database.
Explain a repository insert failure using sanitized database error evidence.
should_trigger_test: Reproduce the constraint failure in disposable Postgres before proposing a fix.
Distinguish a domain conflict from an unexpected driver error wrapper.
should_not_trigger: Find the suspected N+1 queries in this Drizzle loader.
Audit retained React state after repeated screen mount and unmount.
Watch this pull request for new review comments and check results.
Freeze edits to the database package for this investigation.
Record this reviewed exact package artifact in dependency-vet.json.
